tagline.en: pi0.5 — Physical Intelligence's next-step VLA policy, tuned for stronger generalization in robot control.
tagline.zh: pi0.5——Physical Intelligence 更进一步的 VLA 策略，面向机器人控制的更强泛化调优。

en: pi0.5 is the follow-on to pi0 from Physical Intelligence, released through the OpenPI project. It is a vision-language-action policy that turns camera observations and a language instruction into robot actions, extending the pi0 approach toward broader generalization across tasks and settings.

It shares OpenPI's design of a vision-language backbone driving action generation, and in WorldFoundry it runs on the in-tree OpenPI runtime with a pi0.5-specific configuration. The default profile targets a LIBERO manipulation setup.
This is an action-generation model: it emits an action trace rather than producing video. The policy checkpoint is obtained separately before you roll it out.
zh: pi0.5 是 Physical Intelligence 在 pi0 之后推出的后续版本，通过 OpenPI 项目发布。它是一个视觉-语言-动作策略，把相机观测和一条语言指令转成机器人动作，在 pi0 方法的基础上进一步扩展了跨任务、跨场景的泛化能力。
它沿用了 OpenPI「以视觉-语言主干驱动动作生成」的设计，在 WorldFoundry 中运行于内置 OpenPI 运行时，并采用 pi0.5 专属配置。默认配置面向 LIBERO 操作场景。
这是一个动作生成模型：它输出的是动作轨迹，而非视频。策略 checkpoint 需在推演前单独获取。

whenToUse.en: Reach for pi0.5 when you want Physical Intelligence's more recent vision-language-action policy for robot control, aimed at broader generalization than pi0.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想使用 Physical Intelligence 更新一代、面向比 pi0 更强泛化的视觉-语言-动作机器人控制策略时，可以选择 pi0.5。

notFor.en: An action-generation policy, not a video model — it outputs action traces. The policy checkpoint is supplied separately.
notFor.zh: 它是动作生成策略，而非视频模型——输出的是动作轨迹。策略 checkpoint 需单独提供。
